name: Lysergic acid hydroxyethylamide
summary: Lysergic acid hydroxyethylamide (LSH or LAH), also known as lysergic acid N-(α-hydroxyethyl)amide or as lysergic acid methyl carbinolamide, is a lysergamide alkaloid related to the psychedelic drug lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD).
